---
title: "Wholeear_IM_SPM_SM_FM_int_SeuratV5"
---

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Load Required Libraries
# -------------------------------
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratData)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scCustomize)   # <-- Required for Convert_Assay()


options(future.globals.maxSize = 50 * 1024^3)  # 50 GB

library(future)
plan("sequential")  
# plan("multisession", workers = 4) # Optional: Speed up large integrations

# -------------------------------
# 1. Load and Convert All Seurat V4 RDS Files to V5 Assay Format
# -------------------------------

# Load and convert IM
IM <- readRDS("IM.earlySPM.final.updated.color.rds") # from Xu et al.,2025 Developmental Cell
DefaultAssay(IM) <- "RNA"
IM <- Convert_Assay(seurat_object = IM, convert_to = "V5")
IM@meta.data$source <- "IM"

# Load and convert SPM
SPM <- readRDS("SPM.final.updated.color.rds") # from this study
DefaultAssay(SPM) <- "RNA"
SPM <- Convert_Assay(seurat_object = SPM, convert_to = "V5")
SPM@meta.data$source <- "SPM"

# Load and convert SM
SM <- readRDS("SM.final.updated.color.rds") # from this study
DefaultAssay(SM) <- "RNA"
SM <- Convert_Assay(seurat_object = SM, convert_to = "V5")
SM@meta.data$source <- "SM"

# Load and convert FM
FM <- readRDS("FM.final.updated.color.rds") # from this study
DefaultAssay(FM) <- "RNA"
FM <- Convert_Assay(seurat_object = FM, convert_to = "V5")
FM@meta.data$source <- "FM"

# Load and convert Whole Ear
whole <- readRDS("whole.ear.final.updated.color.rds") # from this study
DefaultAssay(whole) <- "RNA"
whole <- Convert_Assay(seurat_object = whole, convert_to = "V5")
whole@meta.data$source <- "WholeEar"

# -------------------------------
# 2. Merge All Samples into One Object
# -------------------------------
All.merge <- merge(x = IM, y = list(SPM, SM, FM, whole))
View(All.merge@meta.data)

# -------------------------------
# 3. Preprocessing: Normalize, Find Variable Features, Scale, PCA
# -------------------------------
All.merge <- NormalizeData(All.merge)
All.merge <- FindVariableFeatures(All.merge, nfeatures = 3000)
All.merge <- ScaleData(All.merge)
All.merge <- RunPCA(All.merge, npcs = 50)

# -------------------------------
# 4. Integrate Using RPCA in Seurat V5
# -------------------------------
All.merge <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = All.merge,
  method = RPCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",
  verbose = FALSE
)

# -------------------------------
# 5. Clustering and UMAP
# -------------------------------
All.merge <- FindNeighbors(All.merge, dims = 1:35, reduction = "integrated.rpca")
All.merge <- FindClusters(All.merge, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "rpca_clusters")
All.merge <- RunUMAP(All.merge, dims = 1:35, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")

# -------------------------------
# 6. Metadata Inspection and Visualization
# -------------------------------
View(All.merge@meta.data)

# Visualizations
p1 <- DimPlot(All.merge, reduction = "umap.rpca", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 8)
p2 <- DimPlot(All.merge, reduction = "umap.rpca", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p3 <- DimPlot(All.merge, reduction = "umap.rpca", group.by = "source", pt.size = 1)
p1 + p2 + p3

# Split UMAP by sample or source
DimPlot(All.merge, reduction = "umap.rpca", split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1.5, label = TRUE, label.size = 8)
DimPlot(All.merge, reduction = "umap.rpca", split.by = "source", pt.size = 1.5, label = TRUE, label.size = 8)

# -------------------------------
# 7. Save Final Integrated Object
# -------------------------------
saveRDS(All.merge, file = "IM_SPM_SM_FM_WholeEar_RPCAint_PC35_res1.rds")

```
